content.text: Pagination is the process of dividing a large set of data into smaller, manageable chunks (pages). It allows users to retrieve a subset of records from a full dataset—useful in REST APIs, tables, or list views.

rows: Reduces the amount of data sent per request
Helps avoid memory overload by fetching only required data
Enables navigation through pages with controls like Next/Prev

content.text: Spring Data JPA provides built-in support for pagination using the following core interfaces:

items: Pageable – used to define pagination parameters like page number and size.
Page<T> – a wrapper that contains data and pagination metadata.
